definitions.explanation: A {屏風|びょうぶ} (folding screen) covered in gold leaf, used as a luxurious backdrop at weddings, ceremonies, and on stages for formal speeches or {落語|らくご}.

examples.japanese: {金屏風|きんびょうぶ}の{前|まえ}で{記念|きねん}{写真|しゃしん}を{撮|と}る。
examples.english: to take a commemorative photo in front of a gold folding screen

examples.japanese: {結婚|けっこん}{式|しき}の{会場|かいじょう}に{金屏風|きんびょうぶ}が{置|お}かれていた。
examples.english: A gold folding screen was placed in the wedding hall.

examples.japanese: {舞台|ぶたい}の{金屏風|きんびょうぶ}が{照明|しょうめい}に{照|て}らされて{輝|かがや}いていた。
examples.english: The gold folding screen on the stage shone under the lighting.

notes:
A gold-leaf {屏風|びょうぶ}, a symbol of formality and celebration; a standard backdrop at weddings and on the {落語|らくご} or speech stage.

RELATED WORDS:
- {屏風|びょうぶ}: folding screen
- {銀屏風|ぎんびょうぶ}: silver folding screen — the counterpart, used at more subdued or refined occasions
